backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing the cinema booking backend with screenings, seat plans, reservations, user profiles, and role-based access control via a MixinAuthorization mixin. Exposes shared/query functions for CRUD operations on all entities, admin role management, and user blocking.
backend/migration.mo: Motoko migration module that upgrades stored reservation data by adding a nullable `userId` field (set to null) to all existing reservations, while passing through screenings, seat plans, and user profiles unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three admin UI features (auto-refresh after reservation accept/deny, optimistic updates with rollback, and cache invalidation after user block) to their implementing files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing component responsibilities, hook changes, and UI/UX improvements across the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes covering background, foreground, primary, secondary, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app titled 'D.K Home Theatre Booking' that mounts the app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing top-level page state (browse, booking, admin) with dark-forced ThemeProvider, Layout shell, page routing via state, and a styled Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin routes by checking Internet Identity authentication and admin role status, showing login or claim-admin UI when access is not granted, and rendering children only for verified admins.
frontend/src/components/admin/Reservatio: Lists all reservations for a specific screening with their status badges and allows admins to confirm or cancel individual reservations via mutation hooks with toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/ScreeningM: Admin UI component for creating, editing, and deleting screenings, including a media list editor for poster images and trailer links with file upload and URL input support.
frontend/src/components/admin/SeatPlanEd: Admin UI component for managing a screening's seat plan, allowing rows of seats to be added or removed and individual seat statuses to be toggled.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackgrou: Memoized decorative background component that renders 48 seeded-random floating cinema-themed emoji/symbol letters with multi-color OKLCH palette and CSS keyframe animations, plus blurred radial gradient blobs.
frontend/src/components/BookingSummary.t: Displays a confirmation screen after a successful booking, showing screening details, selected seats, customer info, and reservation ID in a styled ticket card layout.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches runtime errors in its subtree and renders a fallback UI with a retry button.
frontend/src/components/FoodMenuItem.tsx: Renders a single food menu item with emoji, name, description, price, and increment/decrement quantity controls.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Provides the app shell with a sticky header containing the logo, navigation links (Screenings, Admin), and an Internet Identity login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/MediaSection.tsx: Renders a poster image gallery and trailer links/embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, or local video) for a screening, with error handling for broken images and invalid URLs.
A form component that collects customer name and contact info, validates input, and submits a seat reservation for a given screening via the makeReservation mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ScreeningList.ts: Displays a grid of movie screening cards with poster images, neon-styled borders, and date/time info, fetching data via `useGetAllScreenings` and calling `onSelectScreening` when a card is clicked.
frontend/src/components/SeatIcon.tsx: Renders a single cinema seat button as an SVG icon with a label, styled according to its status (available, selected, reserved, or booked), memoized to avoid unnecessary re-renders.
frontend/src/components/SeatMap.tsx: Fetches and renders a full cinema seat plan for a given screening, organizing seats into labeled rows and delegating individual seat rendering to `SeatIcon`, with loading skeletons and error/empty states.
frontend/src/components/TheaterBanner.ts: Renders a decorative hero banner for the theatre with a blurred backdrop image, layered radial gradients, film-strip borders, and a centered theatre logo with a premium badge.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor using React Query, initializing admin access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, covering screenings, seat plans, reservations, user profiles, and admin role management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining a cinematic dark theme with OKLCH CSS custom properties, Tailwind base/utilities, custom theatre-specific tokens, and utility classes for seats and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page protected by AdminGuard that displays a two-column layout with a ScreeningManager on the left and tabbed SeatPlanEditor/ReservationManager on the right for a selected screening.
frontend/src/pages/BillReceipt.tsx: Displays a styled booking confirmation receipt with seat, food, GST, and service fee totals, along with generated transaction and booking reference IDs.
frontend/src/pages/BookingFlow.tsx: Multi-step booking flow component managing transitions between seat selection, reservation form, food items, and bill receipt steps for a given screening.
frontend/src/pages/Browse.tsx: Main browse page that renders an animated background, a theatre banner, and a list of upcoming screenings for the user to select.
frontend/src/pages/FoodItems.tsx: Food and beverage selection page showing a menu of items with quantity controls, a running total, and options to continue or skip to the next booking step.
frontend/src/utils/debounce.ts: Provides a generic debounce function and a createSubmitGuard utility to prevent rapid repeated function calls within a specified time window.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts (Playfair Display, Inter, Fredoka One), OKLCH-based color tokens (theatre, sidebar, chart, cinematic palette), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for 'D.K Home Theatre Booking' app, tracking existing features (reservation refresh, optimistic UI, blocked-user cleanup) and pending bug fixes/feature requests around ticket acceptance speed, blocked-user booking removal, and UI state updates.
